Online PvP is off until you add a free Supabase backend (GitHub Pages cannot host it). Steps: (1) Create a project at supabase.com (2) SQL Editor → run supabase/migrations/001_online_pvp.sql then 002_gauntlet_leaderboard.sql (3) Database → Publications → supabase_realtime → enable table pvp_rooms (4) Project Settings → API → copy URL + anon key into online-config.js in your repo → push to GitHub. Then reload this page.

Battle Frontier

Wild Encounter

Cable Link Station

0G

Random trades from anonymous partners — random species, random typing. Three options per Pokémon:
Reroll same grade, T3 build (6,000–14,000G) · Upgrade to a stronger grade, T4 build (9,000–22,000G) · Rebuild same species, new T3 build (5,000G). Flat prices — no city-spam ramp. Priced as a premium over the Tutor + Dojo + EV-Trainer ladder. To evolve, visit the Evolution Tutor.

Evolution Tutor

0G

Choose an evolution path. Disabled branches are greyed out. Nature, ability, item, EVs, legal moves, and battle gimmick all carry over.

Run Artifacts

Most artifacts affect BOTH you and the enemy for your entire run. The Cursed Amulet Coin is the one exception — its bonus and its curse only touch your team.

Story team tester

Generates the same assignTrainers + rollTrainerTeam pipeline as a New Adventure (sequential RNG). City screens and other story actions are not simulated, so a live run can diverge slightly; trainer picks and team rolls match a clean generator pass.
